name: Kyouhaku 3 ~Haruka ni Hibiku Hikari to Kage no Uta~
original_name: 脅迫3～遙かに響く光と影の淫哀歌～
source: Sawane Haruka is a passionate idol working her way to the top with the support of her sickly mother, Yoko, and her dedicated manager, Ayano. One day, the president of the agency she belongs to is arrested on sexual assault charges, forcing her to switch agencies to "Mirror Burns". There, she forms an idol unit called "Nude Lips" with her classmate Andou Remi and the popular idol Nagumo Yuuna, unaware of the trap awaiting her. Just before their debut, she is kidnapped and forcibly defiled. A video of the incident is sold online as an adult video, driving her into a corner and leaving her emotionally devastated. In order to divert the media's attention away from the company, the president of her new agency forces her to adopt a fake identity named "Haruna" and appear in more adult videos. As Haruka begins a dangerous dance between her identity as an idol and her alter ego as an AV performer, the truth behind her tragedy begins to unravel, threatening to drag those around her into a bottomless darkness.....
